definitions.short: Tsalmon , the name of a place in Palestine and of an Israelite
definitions.full: H6756. Tsalmown I. צַלְמוֺן proper name, of a mountain 1. ׳הַרצֿ Judg 9:48 near Shechem, not identified, compare GFM, Buhl Geogr. 100 ; Ερμων (erroneous). 2 snow-capped mountain Psa 68:14 , probably east of Jordan (in Hauran according to Wetzst, compare Buhl Geogr. 118 ), Σελμων . II. צַלְמוֺן proper name, masculine a hero of David 2 Samuel 2; 2Sam 23:28 (= עִילַי I Chron 2 Samuel 11:29), ( Σ ) ελλω , ᵐ5 L Ελιμαν . צַלְמָוֶת see III. צלל .

occurrences.englishText: Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him; and Abimelech took an ax in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it up, and laid it on his shoulder. Then he said to the people who were with him, “What you have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done!”
Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
